card.name: Ending of "Inducers" in CYP headings
card.fires_on: The final piece "ers" of the word "Inducers", mostly in headings such as "CYP3A4 Inducers" or "Inhibitors and Inducers". It also fires on a few other split-word endings.

modes.label: Inducers in CYP headings
modes.description: The "ers" ending of Inducers after Induc, in enzyme interaction headings.

modes.description: Occasional fires partway through other split words, such as a math term or an acronym.
